_about: Public-domain A. J. Gordon (Adoniram Judson Gordon, 1836-1895, Baptist, Clarendon Street Church, Boston) for the Word Hoard: The Ministry of the Spirit (Project Gutenberg, 1894), and from Internet Archive scans In Christ (1872), The Ministry of Healing (1882), The Two-Fold Life (1883), Ecce Venit (catalogued 1889), The Holy Spirit in Missions (copyright 1893), Elements of Christian Character (1895), How Christ Came to Church (1895) and the tract God's Tenth. His hymnals are held as alternates, not shelved. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
